**M&T Bank (MTB) 3Q26: Sequential Miss on Higher Tech Spend and Credit Costs Despite Solid Growth**

**Headline & EPS Drivers:** Discussing **reported** GAAP diluted EPS (with zero notable items in 3Q26 or 2Q26; net operating EPS excluding $0.04 of intangible amortization was $5.08 vs. $5.35 in 2Q26) [B0062, B0691, B0756], MTB earned $5.04 in 3Q26, missing 2Q26 ($5.32) by $0.28 (-5% QoQ), though up 5% YoY [B0021, B0756]. The sequential decline was driven by a $44 million (+3%) jump in noninterest expense [B0018], a $15 million (+13%) increase in credit provision [B0125], and $42 million in preferred dividends (up from prior quarters after preferred issuance) [B0190, B0444], while total revenue was essentially flat (+$4 million QoQ) [B0756].

**Revenue & Margin:** GAAP NII edged up $1 million QoQ to $1,793 million ($1,805 million TE) as an extra day and $2.6 billion (+2% QoQ) of average loan growth—led by CRE (+$1.6 billion), consumer (+$634 million), and residential real estate (+$367 million)—were offset by lower nonaccrual interest and higher funding costs [B0013, B0015, B0043, B0044]. FTE NIM compressed 5 bps QoQ to 3.65% (-3 bps from nonaccrual interest, -2 bps from higher funding costs), as interest-bearing deposit costs rose 10 bps to 2.05% alongside $3.3 billion (+2% QoQ) of average deposit growth [B0033, B0760, B0768]. Noninterest income rose $3 million QoQ to $743 million, as a $25 million jump in mortgage banking (from $62.9 billion of new residential sub-servicing added in June) offset lower BLG distributions (-$10 million), capital markets (-$9 million), and seasonal trust fees (-$5 million) [B0143, B0147-B0151]. Noninterest expense rose $44 million to $1,393 million on outside data processing/software (+$19 million), professional services (+$8 million), salaries (+$6 million), and Visa litigation (+$6 million), pushing the efficiency ratio up 160 bps to 54.4% [B0034, B0168-B0173].

**Credit:** Credit normalized upward from a low 2Q26 base. NCOs jumped to $127 million (0.35% vs. 0.23% in 2Q26), nonaccruals rose 7% to $1,298 million (0.90% vs. 0.85%), and criticized C&I/CRE loans rose $245 million to $6.1 billion (6.6%) [B0114, B0118, B0126, B0127, B0776]. Provision increased $15 million to $135 million, with ALLL/loans easing 2 bps to 1.51% [B0120, B0125].

**Capital & Returns:** Net operating ROTCE declined 128 bps QoQ to a still-strong 17.29% [B0064]. CET1 slipped 3 bps to 10.16% after $323 million in buybacks [B0038, B0048], while TBVPS fell 1% to $115.88 on $588 million of AOCI headwinds [B0066, B0191].

**Guidance & Thesis:** 4Q26 outlook guides TE NII up to $1.83–$1.85 billion (mid-3.60s NIM), fees $710–$730 million, GAAP expenses $1.39–$1.41 billion, and NCOs 35–40 bps [B0784]. Higher expenses and normalizing credit temper near-term upside, leaving the thesis intact but balanced.
